title: SI NO. 2 of 2026 SUPPLIES CONTROL (PRICES) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 41) REGULATIONS, 2025
text:

BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 2 of 2026
REGULATIONS made by the Minister responsible for
Supplies Control in exercise of the powers conferred upon
him by section 3 of the Supplies Control Act, Chapter
293 of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2020, and all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 10th January, 2026)
1. These Regulations may be cited as the
Citation.
SUPPLIES CONTROL (PRICES) (AMENDMENT)
(NO. 41) REGULATIONS, 2025,
and shall be read and construed as one with the Supplies Sub. Leg, 2020
Edn. CAP. 293
Control (Prices) Regulations, which, as amended, are
p.49
hereinafter referred to as the principal Regulations.
2. The principal Regulations are amended in Part D of the Amendment of
First Schedule.
First Schedule by repealing the retail prices for Liquefied
Petroleum Gas, and substituting the following, effective 12th
December, 2025 –
